<p>Generate dialect-appropriate date addition SQL
</p>

## Usage

```r
sql_date_add(.con, unit, n_expr, date_col = "date")
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-con"><code>.con</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-con"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A DBI connection object</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-unit"><code>unit</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-unit"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A character string: "month", "week", etc.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-n-expr"><code>n_expr</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-n-expr"></a></dt>
<dd><p>An expression string for the number of units</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-date-col"><code>date_col</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-date-col"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A character string for the date column name</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>dplyr::sql</code> object
</p>
